issue.title: bob-mac-capture has no .swift-format config, so agents re-indent whole files between 2 and 4 spaces

task_type_fields.impact: Whole-file re-indents bury real changes in 10k-line diffs, so review and blame stop being useful, and concurrent agents editing the same file get avoidable merge conflicts. Fix: add a `.swift-format` with the majority style (4-space indentation; set lineLength to match existing code), mention it in AGENTS.md, and re-indent the minority files in one dedicated commit so later diffs stay small.
task_type_fields.repro:
1. In bob-mac-capture, `ls -a` shows no `.swift-format` config, so `swift format` / `swift-format` use the tool default (2-space indentation).
2. Count leading indentation per tracked Swift file: about 75 files use 4 spaces and 23 use 2 spaces (e.g. Sources/CaptureCore/{CaptureModels,BobProcessClient,BobErrors,BobEnvironment}.swift, Sources/RefsCore/RefsStores.swift, Sources/BobMacCapture/CapturePullInChoice.swift).
3. `git show cb4c01e --stat` (bob-cli-8b.3) reports 11,560 insertions / 10,192 deletions, but `git show cb4c01e --stat -w` reports 1,532 / 164: an agent ran the formatter and re-indented CaptureModels.swift and CaptureModelTests.swift wholesale from 4 to 2 spaces.
Root cause: no repo formatter config, and `just format-lint` / CI lint only warn on indentation, so whichever agent formats a file silently switches its style.

issue.creation_reason: While landing bob-cli-8b, cb4c01e's 10k-line diff turned out to be mostly whitespace from a formatter run; with no config, this will keep happening on every agent that formats.
